name: KPR security droid
description: The KPR security droid, also known as the KPR servant droid, was a model of security droid. During the Galactic Civil War, several KPR units were active on the planet Tatooine. Owen Lars had a KPR unit at his moisture farm. A couple of KPRs were aboard the sandcrawler which captured C-3PO and R2-D2.
